name: Idagawa Ren
source:
"The one to conquer the country... will be me, Idagawa Ren." 

 He's the executive of 750 School in Tokyo, as well as the Gang Leader. He's the head of the largest biker gang in Kanto, Gokuren. He has the same goal as [url=/c368]Rouga[/url], conquering the nation. 

 Battle quote - "I don't spare any who foolishly block my way..."

[Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/]Alice Soft wiki[/url]]
